review.decision: The focus repair introduces Angular core afterNextRender, AfterRenderRef, ApplicationRef, and Injector. Their exact advertised-minimum declarations are public and nondeprecated; afterNextRender supports the mixedReadWrite phase, manualCleanup, and explicit injector; AfterRenderRef exposes destroy. Existing imports change only in the two exact source transitions and their scanned occurrences. No historical roster or disposition is rewritten.
